assessment.question:
### Exercise 15.4: Identify angles at intersecting lines

The diagram shows line $IJ$ intersecting line $EF$. The intersecting lines create four different angles. These angles are labelled $\alpha$, $\beta$, $\delta$, and $x$.

[Source image: https://electricbookworks.github.io/siyavula-open-textbooks-images/items/images/web/sv-qb-jss1-15-0_043.png]

3. Name two pairs of vertically opposite angles.
assessment.expected_answer:
Vertically opposite angles share the same vertex and are on opposite sides of the vertex.

$\hat{x}$ and $\hat{\alpha}$ are vertically opposite angles.

$\hat{\delta}$ and $\hat{\beta}$ are vertically opposite angles.

assessment.question:
### Exercise 15.4: Identify angles at intersecting lines

The diagram shows line $IJ$ intersecting line $EF$. The intersecting lines create four different angles. These angles are labelled $\alpha$, $\beta$, $\delta$, and $x$.

[Source image: https://electricbookworks.github.io/siyavula-open-textbooks-images/items/images/web/sv-qb-jss1-15-0_043.png]

2. Which angle or angles are adjacent to $\hat{\delta}$?
assessment.expected_answer:
Adjacent angles share the same vertex and a common arm.

$\hat{x}$ is adjacent to $\hat{\delta}$.

$\hat{\alpha}$ is adjacent to $\hat{\delta}$.

assessment.question:
### Exercise 15.6: Recognise pairs of angles between parallel lines

3. In the diagram below, $RS \parallel TO$ and $MN$ is a transversal.

Source image: https://electricbookworks.github.io/siyavula-open-textbooks-images/items/images/web/ebw-jss1-15-031.png

What type of angle pair is shown by the shaded angles?

What is the relationship between the two angles?
assessment.expected_answer:
If we highlight the angles we will see an "N" shape.

Highlighted image: https://electricbookworks.github.io/siyavula-open-textbooks-images/items/images/web/ebw-jss1-15-032.png

The shaded angles are alternate angles.

The alternate angles are equal because $RS \parallel TO$.

assessment.question:
### Exercise 15.4: Identify angles at intersecting lines

The diagram shows line $IJ$ intersecting line $EF$. The intersecting lines create four different angles. These angles are labelled $\alpha$, $\beta$, $\delta$, and $x$.

[Source image: https://electricbookworks.github.io/siyavula-open-textbooks-images/items/images/web/sv-qb-jss1-15-0_043.png]

4. Say whether the following statement is true or false:

$$
\hat{x} = \hat{\alpha}
$$
assessment.expected_answer:
$\hat{x}$ and $\hat {\alpha}$ are vertically opposite angles and vertically opposite angles are equal.

The statement is true.
